title: Prospective randomized comparison of posterior and anterior lumbar approach for renal surgery – the APPROACH 2.0 study
summary: The overall aim of the study is to conduct a comparative analysis of the posterior and anterior lumbar approach to the kidney in open renal surgery. The advantages and disadvantages of each approach will be described and compared in order to provide recommendations for selecting one approach over the other.

interventions.name: Anterior lumbar approach for renal surgery
Posterior lumbar approach for renal surgery

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with an indication for open partial nephrectomy or nephrectomy
Exclusion criteria:
Patients under 18 years of age
Patients who are unable to complete questionnaires independently, for example due to comorbidities
Patients with prior surgery on the same kidney (e.g., repeat surgery for recurrence)
Renal tumours > 7 cm in patients scheduled to undergo partial nephrectomy
Locally advanced tumours in patients scheduled to undergo nephrectomy (≥ cT3)
